summary: issue 2 CLONE - Part Description presentation: Description Field Appears Empty When Editing
reported_issue: On WO S-1820 Parts screen, when the user attempts to edit a part description, the description box shows up as EMPTY even though the text exists, forcing them to retype it.
expected_after_fix: The existing description text must be shown in the field when editing; the box should not appear empty.
steps_i_followed: Booted SPA as admin (exact WO S-1820 is customer data not on staging; inferred repro on an existing staging WO with part descriptions).
Opened approved WO S9-24706 => Parts tab (part-requests) where part descriptions are edited inline.
Read the description controls both visually (screenshot) and via DOM (q-select native/label text).
Verified the displayed value for each part's Description field.
actual_now: The Description field is populated and clearly shows the existing text when editing. The three part rows display 'special', 'Core for special', and 'ANTI-TURN WASHER , RIDEWELL' in their editable Description controls (visible in the screenshot and confirmed via the q-select native/label text). The field is not empty. (The underlying input.value is empty only because Description is a Quasar q-select whose selected label carries the value — the user sees the description text, which is the point of the ticket.)
notes: Original WO S-1820 (SS Repair Ltd) not present on disposable staging shop; tested equivalent flow on staging. Description text renders in the edit field, so the reported 'appears empty' symptom does not reproduce. Confidence medium since exact original record not reproducible.
